📱 Phone away while working Not beside you, even on silent. Put it in another room/ out of eyesight /covered in a box may be. One task at a time Multitasking = attention switching. 45 min focus → 10 min break Repeat 2–3 times instead of forcing hours of continuous work. Learn → Close → Recall → Apply After studying, close the material and write 3–5 things you remember. Then use them. Control short-form content Don't randomly open Reels/Shorts throughout the day. Keep a fixed time window. Find your peak brain hours Notice when you're naturally most focused and reserve that time for difficult work. Don't chase the 5 AM lifestyle The goal is good sleep + your best cognitive hours, not waking up at a particular time. Let your brain be bored sometimes Walk, shower, drink tea without constantly consuming content. The one formula to remember: Less stimulation → deeper focus → better memory → better learning. And for your studying/career work: Phone away → 45 min deep work → 10 min break → recall what you learned → apply it.
